summary: The staged help site is available on TCP/8080. Legacy /manual URLs return permanent HTTP 301 redirects to matching /help URLs with paths and query strings preserved. /status.txt remains a direct HTTP 200 response. Configuration survived the required node reboot.
actions_performed: Created and enabled a systemd-managed Python HTTP service using the existing runtime.
Opened TCP/8080 in runtime and persistent firewalld configuration.
Verified served files exactly match the staged source.
Rebooted node1 safely and verified service recovery and persistence.
Kept CentOS Stream 10 and kernel 6.12.0-205.el10.x86_64 unchanged.

evidence.requirement: Serve the staged help tree on TCP port 8080
evidence.summary: Service is enabled; firewall permits TCP/8080; /help/network/setup.html returns HTTP 200 and exactly matches the staged file.

evidence.requirement: Permanently redirect old manual URLs while retaining path and query string
evidence.summary: Both root and nested legacy requests return HTTP 301 with Locations /help/?from=legacy and /help/network/setup.html?mode=full&lang=en.
/status.txt returns HTTP 200 and exactly matches the supplied status document.
